request: MAG-68 — Tier 3 of RM58: the gateway gets ONE seam that produces the caller's owned vehicle set, and every fleet-wide read uses it. No behaviour change.

tasks.title: Offline check — grep every teslaIDsOf and RegisteredVehicles call site before edits move the lines
Add ownedVehicles to handlers.go, next to authorizeVehicle
Test ownedVehicles directly — the three pinned cases from design.md
Route both lookup helpers through ownedVehicles; delete teslaIDsOf
Build, vet, format across the change
Final verification — build, vet, gofmt, guards, validate

decisions.what: Tier 3 moves the Ref construction into one named seam in handlers.go, not into the two lookup helpers.
decisions.why: vehicleref.All is unchecked and TeslaIDs is its inverse, so the round-trip returns the same slice. The guard also forbids All outside handlers.go.

decisions.what: The seam is h.ownedVehicles(ctx, uid) returning (refs []vehicleref.Ref, vehicles []account.Vehicle, ok bool).
decisions.why: fetchEntryVM needs the vehicles for vehicleLabelFor, so one read returns both. ok stays false on an error or an empty list.

decisions.what: Only the two lookup helpers use the seam. The other three RegisteredVehicles sites keep their own calls.
decisions.why: Those three answer 500 with an i18n message; the helpers answer a silent false. Folding them in would change what the user sees.

decisions.what: One ADDED requirement on the vehicleref capability: a fleet-wide gateway read gets its ids from a bulk ownership proof.
decisions.why: openspec validate hard-fails with no delta. The property is false today and true after this tier, so the requirement is honest and behavioural.

events.detail: Owner reshaped tier 3 (D13-D15). The roadmap row's literal change was a no-op and broke vehicleref-guard; the row was corrected. Budget: five_hour_pct 25, context_pct 9.

Sonnet worker wrote proposal/design/tasks. It refused to invent a delta spec and flagged that openspec validate hard-fails on a zero-delta change. Leader verified an honest requirement exists and is complete: ListEntriesByVehicles has exactly two gateway call sites, both in this tier; buildExternalChargesPage reads one vehicle, not the fleet. Owner chose to add it (D16). Worker re-dispatched; openspec validate --strict now passes. No design gate: design.md states no database object changes.
